== Closing Blessing ==
We came together to do our practice, clear our minds, build connection and comfort. We were called to use that connection to work toward our highest aspirations. We concentrated on the direction, not the size, of our efforts, having faith that trillions of allies will emerge. May we carry this faith, comfort, connection, and commitment through the week until we can be together again. --Blessed Be
